name: Same-Shadow 581-Concept Obstructions with Diamond and Antichain Attachments
definition: Over the same labelled $577$-concept three-core, use four fixed acquired pairs. In the first attachment data set, recursive targets produce new concepts $8194,8198,24578,24582$ and a four-element diamond. In the second, independent root-square targets produce $8194,8196,16386,16388$ and an antichain.
parameters: Both outputs have $581$ concepts and VC dimension $3$. The diamond attachment poset has six ample intermediate families; the antichain has sixteen.
properties: The two families have the same full shattered complex and the same labelled three-core, but they are not graph-isomorphic: the diamond output has one corner and the antichain output has four. Thus the acquired support list, shattered complex, and labelled core do not recover the attachment targets or the resulting graph.
